Overview

Ancona is a city in Marche with a population of 100,000. The Marche region’s capital, a major Adriatic port with a beautiful historic center, a Romanesque cathedral, and stunning coastal views. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews older, with a median age of 47.0.
